faq.q: What is the origin of Rufat?
faq.a: Rufat is associated with Arabic. Rufat is an Azerbaijani male given name. No confident lexical sense could be established, so no meaning is asserted.
Yes — the underlying form رُفَات is Arabic.
Rufat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
